country.evidence_quote: Founded in 1975, Academia Marco is a Private Technical School, located in the centre of Zaragoza (Spain), where around 500 students are engaged in studies here. As far as Education is concerned, this Technical School offers a wide range of specific Vocational Education and Training, from Initial to Advanced level and Dual Training. Furthermore, this Education Institution is authorised to teach some training courses from INAEM (Spanish Public Employment Service) to unemployed people.
